myFarm.title: My Farm
myFarm.priceSaved: Price updated. The old price stays in the history.
myFarm.savedEmpty: Tap the heart on a farm to keep it here.
myFarm.haveFarmD: Put it on the map in five short steps.
myFarm.priceError: Not saved. Check your connection and try again.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.empty: No messages yet. Open a farm and tap Message, or place an order.
inbox.safety: Pay only through i12farm or meet in person. i12farm never asks for your PIN.

auth.title: Sign in to i12farm
auth.subtitle: Pin your farm, order from farmers and talk to buyers.
auth.emailSent: If that email can be used, a sign-in link is on its way. It works once, for one hour.
auth.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.noEmail: No smartphone? A field agent can register your farm for you.
auth.phoneHint: You sign in with this number. It is not shown publicly.
auth.emailOptionalHint: Lets you get a sign-in link if you forget your password.
auth.consent: I agree that i12farm keeps my details to show my farm and connect me with buyers and services.
auth.emailTitle: Sign in with an email link
auth.emailDev: Development server without email: open the link here.
auth.forgotBody: If your account has an email, use the email link below. If not, ask your field agent or i12farm support for a one-time sign-in link.
auth.linkBody: Tap the button to sign in on this phone. The link works once.

errors.missing: Enter your phone or email and your password.
errors.badCredentials: That phone or email and password don't match.
errors.tooMany: Too many tries. Wait 15 minutes and try again.
errors.suspended: This account is suspended. Contact i12farm support.
errors.phoneInvalid: Use a Kenyan mobile number, like 0712 345 678.
errors.emailInvalid: That email address doesn't look right.
errors.passwordCommon: That password is too easy to guess.
errors.phoneTaken: An account already uses this phone number. Sign in instead.
errors.emailTaken: An account already uses this email. Sign in instead.
errors.signedOut: You were signed out. Sign in again.
errors.needOneIdentifier: Keep a phone number or an email to sign in with.
errors.identifierTaken: Another account already uses that phone or email.
errors.claimCodeWrong: That code is wrong, used or expired. Ask your field agent for a new one.
errors.google: Google sign-in didn't work. Try again, or use your phone number.
errors.google_off: Google sign-in isn't set up on this server yet.
errors.noEmail: Your Google account has no verified email.
errors.link: That sign-in link has expired or was already used.
errors.callback: Sign-in didn't finish. Please try again.

offline.title: No connection
offline.body: Your phone is offline. Pages you opened recently are still available. We'll reconnect automatically.

farm.approxNote: Approximate location, within about 1 km. The farmer shares the exact spot when you call.
farm.exactNote: Exact location shared by the farmer.
farm.hiddenNote: This farm is not shown on the map.

wizard.descHint: What do you grow or keep? What should buyers know?
wizard.moveMap: Drag the map until the pin sits on the farm.
wizard.visApproxD: Buyers see the area, within about 1 km.
wizard.visExactD: Best for shops, clinics and farm tours.
wizard.visHiddenD: Not on the map. Buyers find the farm by search.
wizard.s4hint: Up to 4 photos. Each one is shrunk on this phone before upload, to save data.
wizard.s5hint: Add at least one product or service. You can change prices any time.
wizard.err1: Add the farm name, farmer and phone number.
wizard.err5: Add at least one product with a price.
wizard.errSave: The farm wasn't saved: {reason}. Check your connection and try again.
wizard.photoFailed: The farm is published, but {n} photo(s) didn't upload. Add them again from My Farm.

account.title: Account
account.contactPhoneHint: Shown to farms you order from.
account.signInHint: You can sign in with either one.
account.passwordChanged: Password saved. Other phones were signed out.
account.setPasswordPrompt: You signed in with a one-time link. Set a new password now so you can sign in next time.
account.claimHint: Did a field agent put your farm on i12farm? Enter the 8-digit code they gave you to manage it yourself.
account.claimed: {farm} is now yours. Find it under My Farm.

cart.otherFarm: Your cart has items from {farm}. Start a new cart for this farm?

checkout.delivery: Delivery (agree the cost with the farmer)
checkout.noteHint: Delivery place and time, or anything else
checkout.name: Your name
checkout.mpesaHint: We send the payment prompt to this phone.
checkout.signInHint: You need an account so the farm can reach you about your order.

checkout.removed: Some items are no longer available and were removed.

orders.noneIncoming: No orders for your farms yet.
orders.waiting: Check your phone and enter your M-Pesa PIN.

farmNext.accepted: Mark it ready when the buyer can collect it or it is out for delivery.
farmNext.ready: Waiting for the buyer to confirm they received it.

buyerNext.paid: Paid. Waiting for the farm to accept.
buyerNext.accepted: The farm is preparing your order.
buyerNext.ready: Your order is ready. Tap “I received it” once you have it.
buyerNext.completed: Done. The farmer is being paid.

orders.refundDue: This order was paid and then cancelled. i12farm refunds the buyer.
